verdict.rationale: Token2's evidence covers local FIDO2, PIV and OTP management tools (desktop, mobile, CLI and browser utilities) and a bulk-enrollment script, but documents no registrable outbound HTTP webhooks. The headless watcher that opens the GUI when a key is inserted is a local device trigger, not a webhook a programmatic consumer can receive, so it earns no credit. Probes found no OpenAPI or other API surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
